name: SignRoute — Unlimited Digital Signatures & Sealed PDF Routing in Google Docs
summary: Lets you draw or stamp a crisp digital signature directly inside Google Docs, embeds a verified signer and timestamp audit block, and exports the sealed PDF straight to your Google Drive folder.
metaDescription: Draw digital signatures on an HTML5 canvas, stamp them into Google Docs, and archive sealed PDFs to Drive with zero per-envelope fees and zero monthly rent.
